description: Discover external registry source candidates through the maintained pinned client. Omit every snapshot field to use the current organization snapshot, or provide registryOrigin, sourceCommit, inventorySha256 and cliArtifactSha256 together. Preserve the exact returned snapshot, item manifest digest, source requirements and unverified upstream preview provenance. Results may be partial; zero compatible candidates in a shortlist does not prove catalog-wide absence. itemType:example lists examples in inventory order; query/tag ranking for examples is unsupported. These are external candidates, not insertable CueFrame cards or rendered fidelity evidence. If no current snapshot exists, explicitly refresh with an observed null snapshot and revision; do not fabricate pins.
name: search_registry_items
title: Search Registry Items
